fact: Angop reports newborn registration at the Mbanza Kongo maternity leads to issue of the first Bilhete de Identidade, under the Nascer com Registo project, since October 2025.
Biometric Update says Angola is beginning to issue national ID cards to newborns at maternity wards, starting in Mbanza Kongo municipality of Zaire province, then its 10 other municipalities.
system: newborn national ID issuance (Born with a birth certificate)
source_slug: 2025-11-17 Angola begins issuance of ID cards to newborns

fact: Angola says its civil registration process includes assigning the Numero Unico do Cidadao (NUC), described as the structuring element enabling the identity card, from the first weeks of life; the document describes this as part of a phased target architecture.
Angola's Justice Minister says the second phase of the universalisation plan provides for issuing the BI at birth in maternity hospitals with civil registration services.
